title: Stretchy material, not upholstery material.
text:
Stretchy material, not upholstery material.. The fabric is very stretchy , and was easy to get on the chairs, although a little narrow for the seats.
That said, the fabric is not see threw but thin, and looks cheesy. It is not thicker upholstery material, or material
For throw pillows.
I would think if your chairs do not have fabric on the seats already, this material would be sliding around when you sit on it.

I also notices in the picture of the before and after, that is a totally different table and chairs set!

product_metadata.title: Dining Chair Cover Seat Protector Super Fit Slipcover Stretch Removable Washable Soft Spandex Fabric for Home Hotel Dining Room Ceremony Banquet Wedding Party Restaurant (A-Grey, 4 Per Set)
